assessment_metadata.name: FAIRA Risk Assessment
assessment_metadata.description: Queensland Government Fair and Innovative Reforms for AI Risk Assessment

questions.question_text: What is the name of the AI system being assessed?
Version or iteration of the AI system
Business unit or department
System owner name
System owner role/position
Assessor name
Assessor role/position
Assessor branch/team
Assessor email

sections.title: Part A1: AI Solution Fundamentals
sections.description: Understanding the core functionality and technical characteristics of the AI system

questions.question_text: What is the primary function of this AI system?
options: Generation (creating new content, data, or outputs)
Detection (identifying patterns, anomalies, or specific features)
Decision support (assisting humans in making decisions)
questions.scoring_notes: Different functions may have different risk profiles

questions.question_text: What version or iteration of the AI system is being assessed?
What AI features or capabilities does the system include?
What types of decisions or tasks does the AI system address?
What are the expected tangible benefits of the AI system?
Does the AI system convert analysis into recommended or automated actions?
What type of AI model or approach does the system use?
What is the source of the AI system?
questions.scoring_notes: Different sources may have different governance implications

questions.question_text: How is the AI system integrated into existing workflows?

sections.title: Part A2: Data and Inputs
sections.description: Understanding data sources, quality, and sensitivity

questions.question_text: How does the system track data lineage and provenance?
Does the system use environmental or contextual data? If yes, describe.
What safeguards are in place to ensure data quality and integrity?
What types of data does the AI system process?
Rate the quality of input data across these dimensions (1=Poor, 5=Excellent)
questions.scoring_notes: Higher data quality may reduce certain risks

questions.question_text: What is the Business Impact Level (BIL) of the data inputs?
questions.scoring_notes: Higher BIL indicates higher sensitivity and risk

questions.question_text: Does the system process regulated or particularly sensitive data?

options: Personal information under Information Privacy Act 2009
Health information under Hospital and Health Boards Act 2011
Criminal justice or law enforcement data

questions.scoring_notes: Processing regulated data increases compliance requirements and risk

questions.question_text: Does the AI system require user inputs during operation?

sections.title: Part A3: Human Interface and Impact
sections.description: Understanding how humans interact with and are affected by the AI system

questions.question_text: What types of human-AI interaction does the system involve?
Rate the expected technical literacy of primary users (1=Low, 5=High)
Which groups are directly impacted by the AI system?
options: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples

questions.question_text: How are users notified that they are interacting with an AI system?
options: Explicit notification at point of interaction
Information in terms of service/privacy policy

questions.question_text: What potential impacts on staff/operators have been identified?
Rate the overall severity of staff impacts (1=Minimal, 5=Severe)
What potential impacts on service recipients/affected groups have been identified?
options: Changes to service access or delivery

questions.question_text: Rate the overall severity of impacts on service recipients (1=Low, 3=High)
questions.scoring_notes: Higher impact severity increases risk level

sections.title: Part A4: Outputs and Actions
sections.description: Understanding what the AI system produces and how outputs are used

questions.question_text: What are the primary outputs of the AI system?
Are outputs shared externally without human review?
questions.scoring_notes: Automated external outputs without review pose higher risk

questions.question_text: What is the Business Impact Level (BIL) of the outputs?
How are outputs tracked and monitored?
Could unauthorized access to outputs cause harm?

conditional_fields.question_text: What types of harm could result?

questions.question_text: What types of regulated or sensitive data are included in outputs?
Describe who has access to outputs containing personal information.
Describe any potential legal or regulatory actions that could result from AI outputs.

sections.title: Part A5: Governance and Oversight
sections.description: Understanding governance structures and oversight mechanisms

questions.question_text: Where does accountability for the AI system ultimately reside?
How are decisions, recommendations, or actions tracked back to the AI system?
What monitoring and review processes are in place?
How frequently is the AI system reviewed for accuracy and fairness?
Has the AI system undergone independent review or audit?
Who is responsible for maintaining and updating the AI system?
What stakeholder engagement has occurred?
What mechanisms exist for detecting potential harm?
Which organizational values or AI principles guide this system?
Does the AI system operate in a sector with specific legal or regulatory obligations?

options: Health sector (e.g., health records, clinical decision support)
Justice sector (e.g., criminal justice data, law enforcement)

show_fields.question_text: Frameworks and standards (select all that apply):

show_fields.placeholder: Please specify any other applicable regulations...

show_fields.question_text: How do these obligations impact the design or operation of the AI system?
show_fields.placeholder: Describe compliance measures, constraints, or design considerations...

questions.question_text: Where will the AI system be deployed?
What frameworks or standards has the AI system been designed to meet?

sections.title: Part B1: Human, Societal and Environmental Wellbeing
sections.description: Assessing broader societal and environmental impacts

questions.question_text: Rate the potential positive or negative impact in each area (1=Very negative, 3=Neutral, 5=Very positive)
What potential negative societal impacts have been identified?
Will the AI system affect employment or work practices?
options: Yes - minor changes to work practices

sections.title: Part B2: Human-Centred Values
sections.description: Assessing alignment with human rights and values

questions.question_text: Has a Human Rights Impact Assessment (HRIA) been completed?
Assess the AI system's impact on human values:
Were diverse perspectives included in the design or testing?

options: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples

sections.title: Part B3: Fairness
sections.description: Assessing fairness and potential for discrimination

questions.question_text: Has the AI system been tested for fairness and bias?
Could the AI system produce unfair or discriminatory outcomes?

conditional_fields.question_text: Which groups may be at risk?
options: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples

sections.title: Part B4: Privacy Protection and Security

questions.question_text: Has a Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) been completed?
Does the AI system collect or process personal information?
What security measures are in place?

sections.title: Part B5: Reliability and Safety
sections.description: Assessing system reliability and safety controls

questions.question_text: Has the AI system been tested for reliability and accuracy?
Is there a documented process for disengaging or overriding the AI system?
Will the AI system be used in a high-risk or safety-critical environment?

sections.title: Part B6: Transparency and Explainability
sections.description: Assessing transparency and ability to explain AI decisions

questions.question_text: Rate the transparency of the AI system's operations (1=Opaque, 5=Fully transparent)
Rate the explainability of the AI system's decisions (1=Not explainable, 5=Fully explainable)
How are users or affected parties informed about how the AI system works?
Are the AI system's limitations and potential errors communicated to users?

conditional_fields.placeholder: Describe how users are informed of system limitations...

sections.title: Part B7: Contestability
sections.description: Assessing ability to challenge AI decisions

questions.question_text: Is there a process for individuals to challenge or appeal AI-informed decisions?

conditional_fields.placeholder: Describe how individuals can challenge decisions...

questions.question_text: What is the timeframe for responding to challenges or appeals?
Describe the governance and oversight arrangements for this AI system.
Are clear roles and responsibilities established for AI system oversight?
Have staff been trained on responsible AI use and limitations?
Are there safeguards to prevent misuse or unintended consequences?
